document.title: Give coupons in stories

source.description_exact: Someone watched your story? Treat ‘em like a VIP with a secret DM coupon
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Give coupons in stories
Business value
Make your DMs feel like an exclusive club. More replies, more redemptions, fewer ghost-town Stories.
How does it work?

When a follower replies to your story — or swipes up if you’re fancy — they trigger a flow that sends them a limited-time discount code or exclusive offer via DM. You can use this to test urgency, reward loyalty, or move inventory without blasting it to everyone.

buttons_exact.text: Reply Contains Specific Words Or Reaction

json_exact.newly_captured: Confirmed current empty resource message: You haven't shared a story yet!; All Stories restored without Save
json_exact.remaining: Actual Story ID and resource-specific controls
json_exact.reason: No active Story resource; publication of a Story is prohibited
json_exact.no_safe_action: Requires user-provided active Story, not additional editor clicking

selection.choose_when: Use a Story keyword and reveal button to deliver a coupon.
selection.avoid_when: The date in the message is copy, not an enforced expiration. Specific Story selection had no resource.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
Specific Story resource selector: Actual Story ID and resource-specific controls. No active Story resource; publication of a Story is prohibited
